records.source: 虽然已经很累，我还是先去病房看了看那个孩子，确认情况稳定后才回办公室休息。
records.before: 林医生是一位男外科医生，刚给一名男孩做完急诊手术。
records.after: 病房外，男孩的家属正在等候消息。
records.output: Although I was already tired, I went to the ward to see the child first. After confirming that the condition was stable, I went back to the office to rest.
